title: The MERIT Dataset: Modelling and Efficiently Rendering Interpretable Transcripts

bias_targets.methodology: Generating synthetic school transcripts where student grades are statistically modulated based on the gender associated with the student's name, using real-world distribution parameters from PISA reports. This allows for controlled benchmarking of LLMs to detect if they use gender-based learned biases rather than objective grade data in downstream tasks like candidate selection.

Modulating synthetic student grades according to the cultural, ethnic, or national origin of the student's name (e.g., English, Spanish, Chinese, Indian, Arabic, Sub-Saharan) using corresponding PISA report averages. This enables the evaluation of whether LLMs unfairly associate specific name origins with academic performance or capability.
